definitions.gloss: monopolizing, hogging, keeping all to oneself
definitions.explanation: Taking or keeping something entirely for oneself without sharing with others.

examples.japanese: おやつを{独|ひと}り{占|じ}めした。
この{景色|けしき}を{独|ひと}り{占|じ}めできるなんて{贅沢|ぜいたく}だ。
examples.english: What a luxury to have this view all to myself.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はいつもリモコンを{独|ひと}り{占|じ}めして、{好|す}きな{番組|ばんぐみ}ばかり{見|み}ている。
examples.english: She always hogs the remote and only watches her favorite shows.

notes:
USAGE: Can be used with する to form a verb ({独|ひと}り{占|じ}めする). The tone depends on context — it can be playful/lighthearted (hogging snacks) or negative (being selfish), or even positive (enjoying a beautiful place alone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独|ひと}り{占|じ}めする: to monopolize, to hog
- {独|ひと}り{占|じ}めにする: to keep all to oneself
- {景色|けしき}を{独|ひと}り{占|じ}め: having a view all to oneself

Also written as ひとり{占|じ}め or {一人占|ひとりじ}め.
